$comment: The hidden debug menu (GAME_DESIGN E.11). Dev words: exempt from approval (decision 64), never in the built page; the menu is built when it opens.

dev.note.ctx: The debug menu: the note field's label (the note rides in the next bug report)

dev.close.ctx: The debug menu: the close button's accessible name (the button shows ×)

dev.throw.ctx: The debug menu: throws a test error, so the error sheet opens (F.5)

dev.marks.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the label of the marks control (GAME_DESIGN 18.6)

dev.marks.on.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: mark drafts, changed and cut lines

dev.marks.drafts.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: mark drafts only

dev.marks.off.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: no marks

dev.check.running.ctx: The debug menu: the replay self-check is running (BUILD_PLAN S3)

dev.check.match.ctx: The debug menu: the golden trips replayed in this phone's engine match Node's hashes

dev.check.differs.ctx: The debug menu: some group's hash differs from Node's; the report says which

dev.map.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: opens the pencil map of the loop at #map, a check view (BUILD_PLAN S4)

dev.hour.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the label of the trail picture's hour control (BUILD_PLAN S5)

dev.hour.auto.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the hour from the trip count (day, dusk, night, then day again)

dev.hour.day.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: show the trail picture by day

dev.hour.dusk.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: show the trail picture at dusk

dev.hour.blue.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: show the trail picture at blue hour

dev.hour.night.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: show the trail picture at night

dev.text.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the label of the box text's font control (pixel or Plain, GAME_DESIGN 11.9)

dev.text.auto.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the font from iOS Larger Text

dev.text.pixel.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the box and the choices in the pixel fonts

dev.text.plain.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the box and the choices in the Plain serif

dev.scenes.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: opens the trail frame's check view at #frame, every picture at every hour (BUILD_PLAN S5)

dev.fixture.three.ctx: The trail frame's check view at #frame, preview only: the fixture with three choices, the SE's budget (BUILD_PLAN S6)

dev.fixture.four.ctx: The trail frame's check view at #frame, preview only: the fixture with four choices, the 15's budget, whose box continues with its more mark (BUILD_PLAN S6)

dev.audio.render.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: renders the UI cues' 10-second demo through the sound's graph in an offline context on this phone, measures it, and checks this phone's synthesis against Node's hashes (BUILD_PLAN S5, 13.5; the result rides in the bug report)

dev.audio.result.ctx: The debug menu, preview only: the 10-second render's line: its true peak, its loudest 3-second loudness, and whether this phone's synthesis matches Node's bit for bit (match, or differs and which cues)

dev.inspect.line.ctx: The line inspector, preview only (a long press on any words in debug mode): the line's state, its length against its max (T15's count) and its batch and number there (BUILD_PLAN 10.3, S5)

dev.inspect.none.ctx: The line inspector, preview only: in place of the batch, for a line in none yet

dev.inspect.copy.ctx: The line inspector, preview only: copies the line's id, hash, state, length, batch, words and ctx, to paste into a chat with your own words after it (GAME_DESIGN 18.6)
